KEA KSRP Hall Ticket 2026 Out - Download Admit Card at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in - Complete Details

KSRP Hall Ticket 2026 has been released on 15 September at cetonline.karnataka.gov.in for the written exam scheduled on 20 September 2026. Download the KSRP/KSISF/IRB Constable Hall Ticket using your registration details and check the exam centre, reporting time, required documents, and important exam-day instructions.

Important Dates

  • Hall Ticket Release Date : September 15, 2026
  • Written Exam Date : September 20, 2026
  • Online Application Start Date : July 13, 2026
  • Online Application Last Date : August 10, 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : August 11, 2026
  • Hall Ticket Release Date : September 15, 2026
  • Written Exam Date : September 20, 2026

Application Fee

  • Posts Covered : Special Reserve Police Constable (KSRP), KSISF, IRB
  • Online Application Start Date : July 13, 2026
  • Online Application Last Date : August 10, 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : August 11, 2026

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
